subject: Post-call: PayGuard discovery — cost confirmation & next asks
messages:
From: Alex Johnson <alex@payguard.io>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-05-13T15:04:00Z
Subject: Quick recap from today — PayGuard needs and budget constraints

Neha / Marissa,

Thanks again for the call earlier — quick recap from our side so we have alignment and clear next steps. High-level pain points we called out:

- Checkout latency spikes during holiday sales windows (95th latency >600ms for fraud-check inference).
- Rising inference spend for real-time classification + embeddings; current finance target is to keep inference below ~$50k/month across all models.
- Need predictable unit economics and an ops story (audit logs, VPC) before committing to a pilot or long-term contract.

Goals we shared:
- Reduce per-transaction inference cost while keeping 95th latency under 300–350ms for critical flows.
- Establish a pilot that demonstrates cost-saving levers (batching, prefix caching, quantization recommendations) and gives us a predictable path to scale.

As discussed, the immediate asks from PayGuard:
1) A short cost model that shows current vs Redwood-optimized spend (monthly) with explicit assumptions (tokens/mo, QPS, avg seq len).
2) A pilot scope we can take to procurement that has measurable KPIs (token reduction %, latency SLOs, timeline).
3) Compliance evidence: SOC2 type II and network isolation options (VPC).

We're expecting a ballpark by EOD tomorrow so we can align with finance ahead of next-week procurement sync.

Thanks — Alex
Alex Johnson | Head of Platform Engineering
PayGuard

Attachment: payguard_sample_anon.csv (sample request payloads, anonymized)
From: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
To: Alex Johnson <alex@payguard.io>, Sara Lim <sara.lim@payguard.io>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-05-13T20:18:00Z
Subject: Re: Quick recap from today — PayGuard needs and budget constraints

Alex — thanks for the clear summary and for sharing the sample file. Felt like we had good alignment on the levers. Below is our preliminary read and the next-step artifacts (attached).

Preliminary cost read (ballpark, conservative assumptions):
- PayGuard reported baseline: ~120M tokens/month across classification + embeddings (from the sample).
- With straightforward batching + prefix/KV caching on repeated checkout prefixes we estimate a ~30–45% effective token reduction for the stateful classification path; embeddings workload sees ~10–20% dedupe/cache savings depending on reuse.
- Rough projected monthly spend (hosted Redwood API estimate, standard quantized model path):
  - Baseline (no optimizations): ~$28,000/month
  - With recommended batching + caching + request-side filtering: ~$17,500/month
  - Implied first-order savings: ~37% (~$10.5k/month)

Notes & assumptions:
- Numbers assume average seq len 280 tokens for classification, embeddings avg 420 tokens when including metadata.
- Peak QPS assumptions: ~40 r/s sustained across critical window; we sized for 2x headroom.
- Does not include potential additional savings from Dedicated/Reserved pricing or more aggressive quantization; we can surface those as a second package.

Attachments included here: redwood_prelim_cost_model.xlsx (spread with assumptions / scenarios) and pilot_scoping.md (recommended 6–8 week pilot with KPIs).

Suggested next steps:
- PayGuard to confirm a short list of 3 typical inference payloads (you already attached one — if you can add an embedding-heavy example and a high-variance long-context example that would help).
- Schedule a 45-min joint meeting with engineering + finance next Wed (May 19) to walk the model and procurement asks. Proposed slots: 10:00am PT or 2:00pm PT.
- We'll include a short appendix in the pilot doc describing VPC/on-prem options and the SOC2 evidence package.

I'll also loop in Ben for any pricing flexibility notes and multi-month committed options.

Best,
Neha Kapoor
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
neha_kapoor@redwood.com

Attachments: redwood_prelim_cost_model.xlsx, pilot_scoping.md

Subject: Re: Quick recap from today — PayGuard needs and budget constraints

Neha / team — thanks for the fast turnaround and the model. Quick notes from procurement / engineering: 

- We'll take the 2:00pm PT slot on May 19 for the model review (confirmed).
- Attached is a second sample (payguard_sample_anon.csv) that contains the embedding-heavy example you requested.
- A couple of asks from procurement: can you include a short line-item showing incremental cost delta if we move to reserved dedicated capacity (3-month and 12-month terms)? Also need a short note on data residency for audit purposes.
- Security asked for SOC2 Type II report + pen test summary; can you surface the links in the meeting materials?

Quick priority: procurement needs to see a pilot scope + expected cost delta to estimate budget approval (target internal decision window: 4–6 weeks post-pilot kickoff).

See you next Wed — Sara

PayGuard
